spec.description: Customer-facing OpenTelemetry trace ingestion (otel-collector to ClickHouse): whether trace data is accepted, delivered and fully accounted for. Separate from the Usage Ingestion dashboard.

spec.title: Collectors reporting
spec.description: Collector pods whose metrics arrived recently, and the uptime of the youngest one. 0 means the collector is down or not scraped: every other panel is then empty because data is missing, not because ingestion is healthy.

spec.title: Spans accepted per second
spec.description: Spans the collector accepted on all receivers, per second. Counted after authentication and decoding, so rejected requests are not in it.

spec.title: Rejected requests (range)
spec.description: Share of requests on the customer port (4318) that the collector answered with an error, over the range. 5xx is on the Hive side (503 is the memory limiter, and Envoy retries each one twice). 401 is either bad customer credentials or the auth service failing; compare with the auth panels.

spec.expr: ((sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(min_over_time(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range]) unless http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?", http_response_status_code=~"5.."} offset $__range) or vector(0))) / clamp_min((sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(min_over_time(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?"}[$__range]) unless http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?"} offset $__range) or vector(0)), 1)

((sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?", http_response_status_code="401"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(min_over_time(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?", http_response_status_code="401"}[$__range]) unless http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?", http_response_status_code="401"} offset $__range) or vector(0))) / clamp_min((sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(min_over_time(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?"}[$__range]) unless http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?"} offset $__range) or vector(0)), 1)

((sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?", http_response_status_code=~"4..", http_response_status_code!="401"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(min_over_time(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?", http_response_status_code=~"4..", http_response_status_code!="401"}[$__range]) unless http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?", http_response_status_code=~"4..", http_response_status_code!="401"} offset $__range) or vector(0))) / clamp_min((sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(min_over_time(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?"}[$__range]) unless http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?"} offset $__range) or vector(0)), 1)

spec.title: ClickHouse queue fill
spec.description: Fill of the fullest pod's ClickHouse sending queue (5000 batches). Healthy is about 0%. It grows when ClickHouse is slow or unreachable, and at 100% every new batch is dropped.

spec.title: Delivered to ClickHouse (range)
spec.description: Spans ClickHouse acknowledged divided by spans accepted, over the range. Judge it on an hour or more: a backlog lowers it and a draining backlog pushes it above 100%. Acknowledged means ClickHouse buffered the async insert, not that the rows are stored.

spec.title: Spans dropped after acceptance (range)
spec.description: Spans the sender got a success response for and the collector then dropped before ClickHouse: retries exhausted or a permanent error (export failed), or the sending queue was at capacity (queue full). Any non-zero value is customer data loss.

spec.expr: (sum(increase({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(min_over_time({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}[$__range]) unless {__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"} offset $__range) or vector(0))

(sum(increase({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(min_over_time({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}[$__range]) unless {__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"} offset $__range) or vector(0))

spec.title: Unaccounted spans (range)
spec.description: Accepted spans that are neither acknowledged nor counted as dropped, as a share of accepted. Positive while the queue is empty means spans vanished without a counter (a pod replaced with a non-empty queue, a crash). Negative means an older backlog was delivered inside the range.

spec.expr: (sum(increase({__name__=~"otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans(_total)?"}[$__range])) - (sum(increase({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_sent_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) - ((sum(increase({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(min_over_time({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}[$__range]) unless {__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"} offset $__range) or vector(0))) - ((sum(increase({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(min_over_time({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}[$__range]) unless {__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"} offset $__range) or vector(0)))) / clamp_min(sum(increase({__name__=~"otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans(_total)?"}[$__range])), 1)

spec.title: Unattributed spans (range)
spec.description: Spans accepted on the unauthenticated internal receiver (ports 4319/4320). They are stored without hive.target_id, so no target can read them. Expected only in local development.

spec.expr: (sum(increase({__name__=~"otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans(_total)?", receiver="otlp/internal"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(min_over_time({__name__=~"otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans(_total)?", receiver="otlp/internal"}[$__range]) unless {__name__=~"otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans(_total)?", receiver="otlp/internal"} offset $__range) or vector(0))

spec.title: Requests per second by status code
spec.description: Requests on the customer port (4318) by response status. The only series that sees 401s and undecodable payloads (400), which never reach the span counters. A 401 rise together with a 200 drop is an auth outage, not bad tokens.

spec.title: Request duration (accepted requests)
spec.description: Collector-side duration of accepted (200) requests. It includes the auth lookup on a cache miss and not the ClickHouse write, which happens after the response. A rising p99 with flat auth latency points at CPU or memory pressure.

spec.title: Auth lookups per second (cache misses only)
spec.description: Calls from the collector to the API's /otel-auth endpoint. Only cache misses are counted (a success is cached 30 s, a failure 10 s), so this is neither request volume nor an error percentage. error mixes rejected credentials with auth-service failures; the log row separates them.

spec.title: Auth lookup duration
spec.description: Duration of the auth lookup; a cache miss blocks the sender's request for this long. A slow error p95 means the API is failing and being retried rather than rejecting credentials. Buckets top out at 10 s.

spec.title: Spans per second by stage
spec.description: Accepted and acknowledged should overlap. Acknowledged below accepted is a growing backlog, above is a backlog draining. Refused spans (the memory limiter) and spans that failed in the receiver were answered with an error, so the sender decides whether they are retried.

spec.title: Spans inside the collector
spec.description: Accepted minus acknowledged minus dropped, from the raw counters of one scrape: the spans sitting in the batch buffer, the queue and the in-flight insert. It should return to about 0. A value that stays high while the queue panel reads 0 is silent loss.

spec.expr: sum by (pod) ({__name__=~"otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans(_total)?"}) - (sum by (pod) ({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_sent_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}) or sum by (pod) ({__name__=~"otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans(_total)?"}) * 0) - (sum by (pod) ({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}) or sum by (pod) ({__name__=~"otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans(_total)?"}) * 0) - (sum by (pod) ({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}) or sum by (pod) ({__name__=~"otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans(_total)?"}) * 0)

spec.title: ClickHouse sending queue (batches)
spec.description: Batches waiting in the ClickHouse sending queue and the insert in flight, against the capacity. A single consumer retries one batch for up to 300 s while the rest wait, so a ClickHouse problem shows here minutes before any failure counter moves. The queue is on pod-local disk: what is queued when a pod is replaced is lost.

spec.title: Dropped spans since pod start
spec.description: Raw counters, not rates, because these series only exist after the first drop. Any step up is lost customer data. permanent=true means ClickHouse rejected a whole batch (up to 5000 spans across targets); queue full means the sending queue was at capacity.

spec.title: Envoy non-200 responses on the trace route
spec.description: Non-200 responses Envoy returned for the trace ingestion route, by status. 200 and 401 access logs are not shipped to Loki, so this is neither volume nor auth failures. 502, 503 and 504 are requests the collector did not answer successfully after Envoy's retries.

spec.title: Collector auth events
spec.description: Splits what the auth metric lumps together: 'authentication failed' with a 4xx status is a rejected credential or target, the other two messages are the auth service failing. Logged on cache misses only.

spec.expr: sum by (msg, status) (count_over_time({container_name="otel-collector"} | json | msg =~ `authentication failed|error calling authentication service|received 5xx response, retrying` [$__interval]))

spec.title: Collector warnings and errors by message
spec.description: Collector warnings and errors by message, without lines from the otlp_grpc/tempo exporter (see Process health). 'Exporting failed' and memory limiter messages here are on the customer data path. 'Sender failed' comes from the batch processor and does not name the exporter: while the Tempo exporter's queue is full it repeats with 'sending queue is full', which is not ClickHouse loss.

spec.title: Collector warning and error lines
spec.description: The log lines behind the panel above.

spec.title: Restarts and pods (range)
spec.description: Uptime resets are in-place container restarts such as OOM kills. A rollout or a scale-down shows only as more pods seen. Either way that pod's batch buffer and on-disk queue are gone.

spec.title: CPU
spec.description: CPU cores used per pod. The autoscaler scales the collector on CPU only.

spec.title: Memory
spec.description: Above 800 MiB the memory limiter answers 503. The limiter's hard limit equals the production pod memory limit (1000 MiB), so an OOM kill can come first. The two reference lines are constants copied from the collector config.

spec.title: otlp_grpc/tempo exporter (not the customer data path)
spec.description: The local-development Tempo exporter that is also in the collector config production runs, where it has no reachable endpoint. It is not the customer data path and is excluded from every other panel. Shown because its failures are expected noise, and because its in-memory queue uses memory the memory limiter counts.

spec.title: Query conventions and known gaps
spec.description: How the queries on this dashboard are written, and what existing telemetry cannot prove.

options.content:
#### Query conventions
- Counters are selected as `{__name__=~"name(_total)?"}`: the collector exposes bare counter names, and Grafana Cloud's OTLP ingestion appends `_total`. One selector works in both.
- `otelcol_*` and `hive_auth_*` are emitted only by the customer-facing collector (the internal observability collector is not scraped), so they carry no pod matcher; that also keeps the dashboard working on a local Prometheus, which has no `pod` label. `http_server_*` is a generic name, so it is pinned to the customer port 4318.
- Every exporter query filters `exporter="clickhouse"`: the collector config also has a local-development `otlp_grpc/tempo` exporter, and its failures would pollute any unfiltered aggregate.
- `send_failed`, `enqueue_failed` and the `otlp/internal` receiver series exist only after their first event, so `rate()` and `increase()` miss the first occurrence. Range stats add the first value of any series born inside the range, and the drop panel plots raw counters.

#### Known gaps (each needs a new metric)
1. Whether rows reached `otel_traces`. The exporter uses `wait_for_async_insert=0`, so acknowledged means buffered by ClickHouse, not stored; a failed flush is invisible and Grafana has no datasource for Hive's ClickHouse.
2. Per-target volume and success. No metric carries a target id, so one target losing everything is invisible in the aggregates.
3. Why a request got 401. Cached auth decisions and missing headers have no metric and no log line, and Envoy 401 access logs are not shipped to Loki.
4. Loss on pod death. The batch buffer, the sending queue (on pod-local disk) and the last unscraped interval have no counter, and there is no restart or OOM metric. Visible only as a positive "Unaccounted spans".
5. Duplicates. A retry after a 5 s insert timeout that had in fact succeeded stores the batch twice.
